note: A single paved loop in the woods beside Panther Creek, set back inland from Cherokee Lake with no lake view. Sites 1-5 back onto the creek; many sites have only an 8x8-ft tent pad. --Claude
summary: TN State Parks campground confirmed: 49 bookable sites (page says 50), water + 20/30/50 A everywhere, sewer at 8 premium sites, back-in paved pads to 66 ft (3 sites under 23 ft); $32-68 (stored $32-50; premium + holiday weekends now read); year-round; showers, laundry, dump, wifi. Not waterfront kept; creekside lead on sites 1-5. Phone confirmed. Website path updated.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (creekside, not changed): the engine's own site notes put sites 1-5 against Panther Creek - site 1 'a few short steps to the creek' (but only 22 ft), site 2 'backs up to the beautiful scenery of the creek located just behind the parking area', 3 'sound and view of the creek', 4-5 'backing up to' the creek's wooded scenery (2-5 take 37-63 ft, sold nightly at the standard rate). Site 2's photo shows a brushy tree line with a footbridge ~20-30 m behind the pad; on Esri the creek is hidden under a continuous canopy strip along the loop's south side. No clear open walk to the water from these photos, so not waterfront stays; a re-audit could test sites 2-5 against the creekside walk-down rule (Caledonia precedent) on the ground or with better photos.
